You command your foes to stop where they are. Make a Society check against the Will DC of each creature you choose within 30 feet: @Check[society|defense:will]. Regardless of your result, the targets are temporarily immune for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{paralyzed} for 1 round and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 2}.

Success The target takes a -10-foot penalty to all its Speeds for 1 minute and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 1}. (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-sovereign.effects.Item.1Xt1b9AKG5eDcBVV])
